projectDescription: A React-based student management system for managing students (alumnos), subjects (materias), and grades (notas), served via Nginx in Docker.
keyFeatures: CRUD management for students (alumnos) with name, email, and date of birth
CRUD management for subjects (materias) linked to grade records
Grade (notas) recording associating students with subjects and numeric scores
Alphabetically sorted lists for students and subjects
Inline edit forms pre-populated from selected list items
Validation modals with error feedback before API submission
Guarded deletion preventing removal of students or subjects with existing grades
Dockerized build using multi-stage Node 20 + Nginx Alpine image
Axios-based API client configured via REACT_APP_API_URL environment variable
